hook.text: 93% of consumers read reviews before buying online. Stars have replaced personal recommendations.

buildup.text: Reviews solve the information asymmetry problem. Sellers know their product's quality; buyers don't.

discovery.text: A one-star increase on Yelp correlates with a 5-9% revenue increase for restaurants.

twist.text: A $1 billion industry exists for fake reviews. Amazon sues fake review brokers regularly.

climax.text: Reviews are powerful but fragile. Platforms spend millions fighting manipulation to maintain trust.

punchline.text: Five stars, 5-9% more revenue. Reviews are the currency of trust.

quiz.question: How much does a one-star Yelp increase affect restaurant revenue?

details.summary: Reviews and ratings create trust in marketplaces by making seller and product quality transparent through buyer feedback. This review economy enables transactions between strangers by providing social proof, but it also creates challenges including fake reviews, review bias, and rating inflation.
details.whyItMatters: Reviews are the trust infrastructure that makes marketplace commerce possible. Without reviews, buyers cannot evaluate sellers they have never met..
takeaways: Reviews create trust between strangers by making quality transparent through peer feedback
Fake reviews and rating inflation threaten the integrity of marketplace trust systems
Review systems exhibit strong bias toward extreme positive or negative experiences

faq.question: Why does rating inflation happen on marketplace platforms?
faq.answer: Social pressure makes leaving negative reviews uncomfortable. Sellers contact dissatisfied buyers to resolve issues in exchange for review removal. Platform designs emphasize positive ratings. Retaliation fears inhibit honest negative feedback..

faq.question: How do marketplaces combat fake reviews?
faq.answer: Verified purchase requirements ensure reviewers actually bought the product. AI detection identifies patterns in fake review language and timing. Review velocity monitoring flags suspicious spikes. Legal action against fake review farms. Weighting reviews by reviewer history and credibility.
